data.title: Universal Games: Hoop & Pole | Talking Stories
data.snippet: Like play chasing and fighting, games involving throwing are pervasive cross-culturally. In hunter-gatherer and other traditional cultures, one of the most common throwing games is hoop and pole, along with its cousins, chunkey and snow snake. The equipment and motor patterns used in these games are similar to those used in hunting and warfare.
